architectureDecisions: D1 -- Verification-first: rerun async-agent-coordinator.test.js and async-agent-coordinator-recovery.test.js against current main with deterministic clock fixtures before adding any fixture; N1/N2/N3 fixtures are added only for gaps found.

D2 -- End-to-end recovery proof: chain coordinator + createDetachedOperationManager (BB-078) + async-result checkpoint (BB-079) across a simulated kill/restart to prove exact-identity recovery and zero duplicate effects.
D3 -- DEV probes stay DEV: rerun bb-080-async-profile.test.mjs to confirm no held-out/HOLD-* execution and no promotion verdict; probe output is never delivery evidence.

D4 -- Repair boundary: a defect found in the signal-fencing path (model.js / model-routing.js / agent-runtime.js / javascript-codeact-strategy.js) is repaired minimally on that exact path, with regression evidence covering the defect and N1/N2/N3.
implementationSlices: S1 -- Steering and coalescing proof [C1, C2]: persist-first USER_INPUT, generation fence, replacement-turn identity, wake coalescing under CAS conflict.
S2 -- STOP and non-authority proof [C3, C5, N1]: stopFence persistence, dispatch blocking, unresolved-ambiguity labeling, no authority crossing.
S3 -- Crash recovery proof [C4, N2, N3]: three-boundary recovery, cross-restart dedupe, grace-window wake convergence, non-cooperating provider fencing.
S4 -- Living Docs: behavior-scoped statements (non-authority, at-most-one generation) bound to exact tests.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: USER_INPUT accepted while a model generation is active is persist-first, increments the generation fence, and schedules exactly one replacement turn covering the input high-water mark; the old generation's late response is discarded before action normalization/tool dispatch/result publication; detached operations continue unless explicitly stopped.
evidenceRequired: Coordinator suite output on current main (19 + 11 tests plus gap-covering fixtures).

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Concurrent operation-transition ingress and duplicate transitionId redelivery coalesce to at most one current wake per drained burst; ingressSeq remains the semantic order; concurrent CAS-conflict ingress cannot create two current wakes; completion-only drains respect completionIdleMs/maxCoalescedTransitions while USER_INPUT, STOP and explicit wakes bypass immediately.
evidenceRequired: Coordinator suite output on current main (19 + 11 tests plus gap-covering fixtures).

acceptanceCriteria.statement: STOP persists the stopFence before any cancellation side effect, blocks all new model/tool dispatch and detached launch/retry, survives restart, and never labels an unresolved post-dispatch effect cancelled (a racing CONFIRMED effect still wins as scheduler SUCCEEDED; unresolved ambiguity stays UNKNOWN).
evidenceRequired: Coordinator suite output on current main (19 + 11 tests plus gap-covering fixtures).

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Crashes at the three boundaries (scheduled-before-dispatch, dispatched-before-terminal, model-in-flight) reconstruct exact pending identity via BB-078 recover(), stage unseen transitions through the BB-079 checkpoint exactly once, abandon the crashed submission, advance the generation, and schedule at most one replacement wake with zero duplicate effects.
evidenceRequired: Coordinator suite output on current main (19 + 11 tests plus gap-covering fixtures).

acceptanceCriteria.statement: No coordinator path confirms an EffectOperation or accepts a product; conflicting transitionId reuse, missing effect identity, corrupted recovery bindings and conflicting operation bindings fail closed; probe metrics never produce a PROMOTE_ASYNC verdict.
evidenceRequired: Coordinator suite output on current main (19 + 11 tests plus gap-covering fixtures). DEV probe output.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Coordinator crash mid-run with a STOP fence persisted but model abort not yet delivered: restart keeps the fence, blocks dispatch, and does not silently resume the old generation.

Coordinator restarted during an active completion-grace window or with pending OPERATION_TRANSITION ingress not yet staged: recovery converges to exactly one wake covering the durable ingress (no duplicate wakes, no dropped wake, no heartbeat self-initiation when nothing is pending).
An ABORT_SIGNAL-declared model adapter that never actually aborts (non-cooperating provider): the late response is still fenced (FENCE_ONLY fallback) with zero action/tool dispatch.
